text:
jia: FYI onboarding Nebula7b-int4. Short prompts look fine but we see semantic drift around 900-1100 tokens. repeating small chunks and embeddings drift. attaching quick repro.

sam: repro? runtime? quant flags?

jia: dedicated int4 cluster. repro: ```bash
rdm-infer --model nebula7b/int4 --prompt long_story.txt --max-tokens 1500
```
Symptoms: coherent until ~1k then lexical collapse, embeddings cos sim vs fp16 drops ~0.12.

eric: likely rotary/KV handshake or head packing. Did conversion use head_fuse or interleaved ordering?

jia: convert v2.1 with head_fuse enabled, rotary_mode=auto, tokenmap packing=true.

maya: also check tokenizer sentinel/pad mapping. we've seen padding folded into pack causing aliasing at scale.

ci-bot: queued job nebula7b-int4-smoke (runner:d-gpu-9). https://ci.internal/runs/9001

sam: quick diff: kv cache matches fp16 for first 512 tokens, divergence starts ~768-1024. observed +1 k-index shift for head groups 4-7. attach /tmp/kv_diff.log

eric: +1 shift => stride/pack mismatch when folding heads. also verify rotary sin/cos length computed vs expected per-head dim. if table is global but indexing assumes per-head blocks you'll get phase slip later.

jia: good call. I'll try rebuild with `--no-head-fuse --rotary-explicit --preserve-tokenpad` and rerun.

ci-bot: rebuild job finished. artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/9001/nebula7b-int4-rebuild.tgz

sam: re-ran long run on rebuilt artifact: no collapse up to 2k tokens, embed cos sim delta ~0.02. So head_fuse + implicit rotary tables triggered the issue.

erm: (typo) eric: great. action items: 1) add convert-time assert that rotary table indexing matches runtime kernel layout 2) default convert to preserve per-head ordering unless explicit kernel validated 3) add 2k longctx smoke to int4 onboarding.

maya: I'll open a tokenmap follow-up to emit packing map in artifacts and run sentinel/pad collision scan during convert.

jia: will update onboarding doc + PR for convert asserts. thanks team :thumbsup:

sam: I'll run a sweep on Zephyr/Orion/Nebula overnight and report any other edgecases.

jia: closing triage unless we see regressions. :coffee:
